item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. Our goal is to prevent that outcome. We need a ban on superintelligence, not a race to build it first.

2. We cannot make humanity safe by winning the race to superintelligence. If anyone builds it with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are working to stop that race and secure a ban.

3. We want a future for humanity. That means stopping the development of superintelligence: if anyone builds it with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are calling for a ban before that happens.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 107 words

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. That is why we are working toward a ban on superintelligence. We are not trying to help one company or country win the race. We are trying to stop a race whose finish line is human extinction. We want humanity to have a future: children growing up, communities flourishing, and generations yet to come living lives worth living. Protecting that future requires more than voluntary promises from the companies building these systems. We need enforceable policy that prevents anyone from building superintelligence, and we are working to make that happen.
